description:
About the Role

As a Growth Product Manager, HTS Media, you will own the roadmap for growing advertiser demand across brands: more qualified pipeline, faster campaign launches and higher advertiser spend within Hopper's ecosystem, working closely with engineering leadership, the sales team, Ad Operations and Account Management. This is a builder role: you will start by owning the roadmap for sales pipeline and sales efficiency, using AI-assisted systems to create demand and make every seller faster, then grow into owning the platform roadmap, including the campaign buying interfaces, in partnership with engineering leadership. In your first year, you'll be judged on the pipeline your systems create, how much faster campaigns go from signed to live, and growth in spend per advertiser.

What would your day-to-day look like

  • Own the roadmap for sales pipeline and sales efficiency, with goals and success metrics tied to a revenue target

  • Build AI-powered systems that generate demand, from account research and signal-based targeting to personalized outreach and follow-up, and measure the pipeline and meetings they produce

  • Grow into owning the platform roadmap for the campaign buying interfaces with engineering leadership: write the specs and decide what gets built, and in what order

  • Work with Ad Operations to remove friction between a signed campaign and a live one

  • Put insights into the buying interface, such as forecasts, benchmarks and media plan recommendations

  • Use SQL on booking, search and campaign data to size opportunities, find advertiser results and decide what to build next

  • Run demand experiments across channels such as LinkedIn, email and events, and track results in internal dashboards

  • Support HTS Media positioning and reusable sales materials (deck templates, one-pagers and case studies), and the HTS Media website and offers site

An ideal candidate has

  • 4+ years of experience in product management or growth at a technology company, ideally in B2B SaaS, marketplaces or ad tech; experience in online advertising or travel is a plus

  • A track record of owning a roadmap and shipping product with engineering that moved a measurable growth metric, such as pipeline, conversion, time to launch or spend per account

  • Hands-on experience building AI-assisted or automated workflows that a real sales team used, with tools such as Clay, n8n, Zapier or Make, and LLM APIs (equivalents are fine), and the ability to describe what you built and what it produced

  • Strong SQL on a cloud data warehouse such as BigQuery, and comfort turning booking, search and ad-serving data into decisions, forecasts and in-product insights

  • Excellent writing and specification skills, and the ability to work with engineering leadership and communicate clearly with advertisers and internal teams

  • Self-driven and organized, and comfortable building without a playbook in a fast-growing business

Perks and benefits of working with us

  • Well-funded and proven startup with large ambitions, competitive salary and the upsides of pre-IPO equity packages

  • Unlimited PTO

  • Carrot Cash travel stipend

  • Access to co-working space on demand through FlexDesk AND Work-from-home stipend

  • Please ask us about our very generous parental leave, much above industry standards!

  • Entrepreneurial culture where pushing limits and taking risks is everyday business

  • Open communication with management and company leadership

  • Small, dynamic teams = massive impact

  • 100% employer paid Medical, Dental and Vision coverage for employees

  • Access to Disability & Life insurance

  • Health Reimbursement Account (HRA)

  • DCA/ FSA and access to 401k plan

About Hopper

At Hopper, we're building the leading travel technology platform in the world, and we're doing it by solving real problems for real travelers globally. Our Hopper consumer booking platforms and HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions), our B2B business, work together to give travelers something the industry has never reliably offered: transparency, flexibility, and real savings on every trip. We combine massive amounts of data and AI with proprietary fintech products to make that happen, not just another booking engine, but a fundamentally better way to plan and experience travel for our customers and our partners. We are proof that better-for-the-customer and better-for-the-business can be one in the same

And we're continuing to grow fast! The Hopper app has been downloaded over 120 million times, with 70% of our users being Gen Z and Millennials, next-generation travelers. Today, our biggest opportunity is powering travel fintech, commerce, and loyalty for some of the biggest brands in the industry. Our first HTS partnership with Capital One helped launch a dedicated travel portal for a major financial brand's cardholders, and we've since expanded across some of the biggest names in travel and banking, including Air Canada, Uber, Royal Bank of Canada (RBC), and Nubank, powering everything from a single fintech integration to a full end-to-end travel loyalty portal.

That's our trajectory: we started as a small, disruptive app within the travel space, and now we're the engine under the hood powering how Travel Tech works.

What that looks like in practice:

  • Billions of dollars in travel and travel fintech move through Hopper and HTS every year

  • Our fintech products, including Cancel for Any Reason and Disruption Assistance for Any Reason, post exceptionally strong customer satisfaction because the terms are clear and resolutions are instant, no questions asked

  • Nearly 30% of app customers add a fintech product to their booking, and those customers are 1.6x more likely to book with us again

  • HTS now drives more than 90% of the business, proof of how fast B2B has scaled

  • Through HTS, any travel provider (airlines, hotels, banks, travel agencies) can plug the company’s fintech, commerce and AI solutions into their own channels, whether that's a single integration or a full end-to-end travel portal

Come take off with us!

#LI-Remote

At Hopper, we leverage AI-driven tools to assist our team in efficiently reviewing applications. These tools help us assess qualifications fairly and objectively. By submitting your application, you acknowledge the use of these automated screening technologies.
